concerns.text: The plan assumes T5‑small can be trained on a 2‑CPU, ~7 GB RAM runner within 6 h (see "Train T5‑small on the processed training split" with batch ≤ 8, epochs ≤ 3). Empirically, T5‑small training on CPU is orders of magnitude slower than on GPU and is unlikely to finish within the allotted time on the specified hardware, risking violation of SC‑003 (Performance).
